user.title: Austrian tariff profile
user.description: Select the grid area and supply type. EEG (Erneuerbare-Energie-Gemeinschaft) tariffs apply only to allocated community energy, with Elektrizitätsabgabe automatically set to zero. Create a separate regular grid profile for residual supply. Scope: grid level 7, non-metered capacity, single tariff.

tariff.title: Tariff assumptions
tariff.description: Confirm the conditions applicable to your supply. Prices are expressed in EUR/kWh excluding VAT. All time windows use Europe/Vienna.

data.household: Reduced Elektrizitätsabgabe for household load profiles

data_description.household: The Entnahmezählpunkt has one of the eligible household load profiles H0, HA or HF. For electricity supplied to a natural person, this qualifies for the reduced Elektrizitätsabgabe in 2026. See [§ 7 Abs. 16 ElAbgG]({elabgg_url}) and [§ 4 Abs. 1 Stromkostenzuschussgesetz]({stromkostenzuschuss_url}).
data_description.snap_eligible: Quarter-hourly consumption is electronically measured and read by the grid operator. SNAP applies on Netzebene 7, from 1 April to 30 September, daily from 10:00 to 16:00, to quantities not allocated to an Erneuerbare-Energie-Gemeinschaft. See [§ 2 Abs. 1 Z 9 und § 5 Abs. 1b SNE-V 2018]({sne_v_url}).
data_description.simulate_winap: WiNAP first applies from 1 October 2027. Enable this option to simulate a reduction of Netznutzungsentgelt using the selected tariff’s SNAP reduction from 1 October to 31 March, daily from 23:00 to 05:00 the following day. This is a simulation assumption; it does not represent the future published WiNAP price. See [§ 7 Abs. 4 und § 32 Abs. 4 SNE-G-V]({sne_g_v_url}).

abort.reconfigure_successful: The tariff assumptions have been updated.
abort.no_tariff_assumptions: EEG profiles apply their reductions and exemptions automatically. No tariff assumptions need to be configured.
